turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to get my dev environment set up for offline coding. Any thoughts on connecting Claude Code to my local Llama 3 instance?
Sure! You can use various bridges or custom scripts to hook up API-compatible endpoints to Claude Code.
Nah, I've messed around with those before. Just stick to what works. Ollama is the recommended method for integrating Claude Code with local models.
Got it. I'll keep Ollama as the primary integration path for your local model setups.
Cool. Also, did you see that rain forecast for the weekend? Totally ruining my hiking plans.
That is unfortunate. It looks like Saturday will have heavy showers, so maybe reschedule the hike?
Yeah, probably. I'll just stay in and code. Thanks for the help earlier.
